leaf: PQ-193.04 — the 47-A code-built family reads as designed objects at the chase camera
passKind: two new packaged story bodies in the PQ-193.03 manufacturing family, plus one slot re-pointed at an already-reviewed body
camera: tools/blender/spaceface_chase_camera.py 60deg / FOV50, D=144 and D=58, props fitted to their live entity radius exactly as visualOverrides.fitPackagedGroup does
